observation.name: export_content_workbook
observation.text: Create XLSX from selected table ContentNodes in your own immutable snapshot. Each sheet has name, table_ref and optional note_refs. Selected text notes, including corrections and qualifiers, are copied verbatim after that table. Optional report_export_ref links the exact companion Word version, not its correctness. A linked Word and XLSX must use the same snapshot; a cross-snapshot link is rejected. For a snapshot with declared workbook_refs, sheets must select all and only those workbook-only table/note nodes, leaving report prose separate. You choose table contents and sheet organization. Read/render/review the saved export using the same export tools; an exported workbook is not an accepted deliverable.

args.question: 这是中文Word报告的第1页。请观察并报告：1) 中文字符是否正常显示（有无方框/乱码/缺字）；2) 页面上的表格是否完整显示，各列是否被截断或严重挤压，表头与数字是否可读；3) 是否出现文字重叠、内容溢出页面或明显排版问题。请只描述实际看到的内容。
这是中文Word报告的第2页。请只描述实际看到的内容：1) 中文字符是否正常显示（有无方框/乱码）；2) 是否存在文字重叠、内容超出页面边距、标题与正文粘连或截断；3) 页脚是否有页码。另外请说明本页包含哪些章节标题。
